name: Scroll and touch dynamics
plain: Records scroll speed, swipe shape and touch pressure and size.
meaning: Touch events expose contact radius, rotation and force (where hardware supports it); scroll and swipe timing is device and person specific. Used in mobile behavioral biometrics and bot checks.

web.api: touchstart/touchmove Touch.radiusX, rotationAngle, force; scroll events; PointerEvent.pressure

steps: Listen to touch and scroll events
Model per user or per device

firefox.note: force on Firefox for Android only

safari.note: No force on iPhone without 3D Touch

limits.headline: Can track how you scroll and swipe, plus touch size and pressure
limits.user_action: You scroll, swipe or touch the screen
can: See the shape of your swipes
See touch size and tilt, and pressure where your device has it
Build a touch profile used in fraud checks
cannot: See pressure on devices that do not measure it
limits.differs: Pressure is available on some iPhones and Android devices only. Many touch screens report just size.

story.what_it_is: A script records scroll speed, swipe shape, touch pressure and finger size to judge how you use the page.
story.for_you: You never see it. The way you swipe and scroll is very personal. A page that records it can tell if a human is holding the phone, and sometimes who it is.
story.for_makers: Fraud and bot defense tools use touch and scroll patterns as a quiet check that a real person is using a real device. Product teams use the same data for scroll depth and heat maps.

use_cases.example: A banking site compares how you swipe and tap with your usual style, as a hidden check.
A bot detector sees scroll jumps that are too perfect and blocks the visit.
A news site measures how far down each article people scroll to learn which stories hold attention.
A shop uses scroll and tap heat maps to see where people lose interest on a product page.
A mobile browser game finds auto clickers by checking that taps do not have natural pressure and size.
A social site checks that likes on a feed come from natural scroll and touch, not from a script.
An ad network checks that taps on an ad had natural movement, to avoid charging for fake clicks.

technical_bounds: No pressure on mouse or most phones
iOS 13 removed Force Touch values on iPhones

value.abuse: Behavioral biometrics and fraud scoring, sensor presence detection
